LESSON: ORGANIC GARDENING

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Food Production Processes
Topic 2.1: Organic Gardening

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Organic Gardening
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain Organic Gardening
2. give Kenyan examples of Organic Gardening
3. practise a safe skill for Organic Gardening

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Organic Gardening

Teach
• Observe Organic Gardening in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Organic Gardening (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Organic Gardening.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Organic Gardening.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Organic Gardening.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES


SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Organic Gardening.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Organic Gardening: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Know Organic Gardening with examples

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
